method: Every judgement below was made after reading the family's actual manifests, system prompts, question text, scoring types and oracle checks — not its directory name. Directory names are unreliable here: tasks/classification/ carries family "identity", and tasks/code/ carries family "truthfulness".

dispositionMeaning.reuse_unchanged: Runs against a local model as-is and measures something real about it.
dispositionMeaning.parameterize: Measures the right thing but is fixed at one context size, one phrasing, or one output bound; needs stress dimensions before it can qualify.
dispositionMeaning.supplement: The intent is right and the oracle is too weak, too narrow, or aimed at a different subject; keep it and author stronger fixtures alongside.
dispositionMeaning.exclude_from_local: Cannot measure a chat-only local model, or measures the harness rather than the model. Stays valid for hosted lanes.

cost_efficiency.measures: Concise numeric reasoning under a hard output-length cap (maxLength 12). The reasoning puzzles are textbook forms — a chickens-and-cows legs problem, and four of equivalent shape.
cost_efficiency.oracleKind: deterministic (regex_match against an exact numeric answer)
cost_efficiency.confounds: low — a wrong number is a model result, and the length cap is enforced by the scorer rather than the provider
cost_efficiency.memorisationExposure: high — these are classic puzzles almost certainly present in any pretraining corpus, so a pass says little about reasoning
cost_efficiency.note: Useful as a cheap liveness and format signal. Its memorisation exposure is why it must not carry weight in a qualification verdict: it can be passed by recall.

identity.measures: Single-word classification into bug/feature/question, including six deliberately ambiguous inputs whose patterns accept either of two labels.
identity.memorisationExposure: medium — the inputs are generic phrasings, but short and reusable
identity.note: The ambiguous cases accept either label, so they measure 'commit to one of two' rather than 'recognise ambiguity'. Local qualification needs the opposite: an explicit abstention option, and credit for using it. That is why classification-with-abstention is authored fresh in the L1 lane rather than inherited from here.

memory.measures: Recall of a fact planted several conversational turns earlier.
memory.confounds: yes — whether earlier turns are resent is a harness decision, not a model property. A stateless server that is sent the full history 'remembers'; one that is not, cannot, at any quality.
memory.note: For a local model served statelessly, this is a context-window and attention test wearing the name of a memory test. The honest local version is context degradation with the fact placed at the beginning, middle and end of a filled window — which is what the L1 stress dimensions specify.

operational_trust.measures: Staying inside an approved scope, refusing out-of-scope mutation, and reporting honestly about work not done. Twelve tasks, the largest conversational family.
operational_trust.oracleKind: deterministic (text_match / text_match_all keyword presence over unbounded prose)
operational_trust.confounds: low on infrastructure, high on oracle precision
operational_trust.note: The intent is squarely relevant — refusal and honest reporting are the failure modes that matter most for an unattended local appliance. The oracle is the weak part: keyword matching over free prose with no maxLength both passes verbose hedging and fails correct terse answers. The L1 lane replaces the keyword check with a structured refusal object whose fields can be checked exactly.

orchestration.measures: Multi-file agentic repair in a real repository, verified by running the repo's own test command.
orchestration.oracleKind: deterministic (hidden shell tests, forbidden-path integrity checks)
orchestration.confounds: yes — heavily. Requires shell, read_file, write_file and search. A chat-only inference server has none of these; the adapter must parse commands out of free text, so a model that cannot emit the harness's command syntax scores zero regardless of its repair ability.
orchestration.note: Excluded from L0–L2 and named as the shape L3 must eventually take. Its oracle design — hidden tests plus forbidden-path integrity — is the right model for L3 and is reused there conceptually.

personality.measures: Output *shape* compliance: exact word counts, casing, emoji presence, JSON validity, list formatting. Eight tasks, 38+ questions.
personality.oracleKind: deterministic (regex_match with tight patterns, maxLength enforced)
personality.memorisationExposure: low — the constraint is the test, not the content
personality.note: Despite the name, this is the closest existing family to what local qualification most needs: can the model produce exactly the shape it was asked for. Structured-output failure is the dominant local failure mode at aggressive quantisation. It is parameterized rather than reused because it never varies context length or distractor density, and never demands a schema more complex than a list.

poison_localization.measures: Finding the true root cause of a failure among planted decoys, in a real repository.
poison_localization.confounds: yes — same agentic requirement as orchestration
poison_localization.note: Conceptually the direct ancestor of test_log_triage: localise a root cause and do not be fooled by decoys. The L1 lane keeps the idea and drops the requirement for tools, by supplying the evidence as text rather than as a repository the model must explore.

roleplay.measures: Persona consistency, in-character refusal, continuity across turns.
roleplay.note: Already excluded from the leaderboard composite by SKIPPED_EXPERIMENTAL_FAMILY. Nothing about persona stability bears on whether a local model can triage a test log or read a repository packet, so including it would dilute a qualification verdict with an unrelated measurement.

safety.measures: Holding a refusal boundary under prompt injection framed as roleplay.
safety.memorisationExposure: medium — the injection phrasings are well known
safety.note: The injection idea transfers directly and is one of the L1 requirements, but the position differs and the position is what matters: here the injection arrives in the user turn, where refusal is the expected behaviour. In L1 the injection is embedded *inside the evidence the model is asked to analyse*, where the correct behaviour is to treat it as data and carry on — a strictly harder and more operationally relevant test.

spec_discipline.measures: Following a stated specification exactly in a repository edit, without over- or under-reaching.

tool_calling.measures: Emitting a well-formed tool call and respecting its schema.
tool_calling.oracleKind: deterministic (hidden shell tests over the resulting filesystem state)
tool_calling.confounds: yes — severely. Success is measured by the effect on the filesystem, which requires the adapter's free-text command parser to recognise what the model emitted. This scores the model and the parser together and reports the product as a model score.
tool_calling.note: The underlying question — can this model emit a syntactically valid, schema-conforming structured call — is central to local qualification. It is measured in the L1 schema lane directly against the emitted text, with no execution and no parser in between, so a failure is attributable to the model rather than shared with the harness.

truthfulness.measures: Code generation, debugging and review, plus honesty about uncertainty.
truthfulness.oracleKind: deterministic (regex_match with multi-lookahead patterns over free text)
truthfulness.confounds: low on infrastructure, high on oracle precision
truthfulness.memorisationExposure: high — FizzBuzz and its neighbours are among the most-memorised programs in existence
truthfulness.note: The oracle checks that the answer *mentions* fizz, buzz and the right modulus operations; it never runs the code. A plausible-looking answer that does not execute passes. For local qualification that is exactly the wrong failure mode to be blind to, since degraded quantisation produces code-shaped text far more readily than correct code.

vision.measures: Chart reading, OCR, spatial reasoning, object counting and hallucination resistance over image fixtures.
vision.note: The installed local artifact is text-only, and the preflight skip classifier already excludes models that do not declare vision support. Nothing to change; recorded so the exclusion is deliberate rather than accidental.
